name: pair-talk
title: Pair Talk
description: Pair talk for a live room: the host pairs everyone (a group of three when the room is odd), each pair gets a prompt card and a timer, and "swap partners" pairs everyone again with someone new. Each phone shows who its partner is, the card and the time…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/pair-talk

Installed to `components/ui/games/pair-talk.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/pair-talk';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/pair-talk

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
